tcs.tc_title: Jump returns playback to the start of the previous song
tcs.test_item: The HU shall provide a method to jump back to the beginning of the previous song
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. The buffer holds two consecutive songs with identifiable boundaries
5. Playback is positioned part way into the later of the two songs
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the song being played and the playback position within it
2. Request the jump to the beginning of the previous song
3. Read the song being played and the playback position
4. Read the audio output
tcs.expected_result:
1. The later song is playing and the position is part way into it
2. The jump request is accepted
3. The earlier song is playing and the position is at its beginning
4. The earlier song is played from its start
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
